articles.title: Jets fall in OT to Bruins in home opener
Jets at Red Wings projected lineups

away.summary: The Jets (1-0-1) are coming off a 3-2 win over Detroit and are projected to use two goaltenders in this back-to-back, with Clay Stevenson likely to make his Jets debut after Stuart Skinner's strong performance. The team has been effective on the power play early in the season, converting 4 of 7 opportunities. Coach Arniel indicated possible skater adjustments due to a busy schedule, but the core lineup remains intact aside from the suspended Hellebuyck and three injured players.

out.detail: Injured (upper body), week to week, missed third straight game

doubtful.detail: Available after lower-body injury, but no decision made on status

returning: could return to lineup after being a healthy scratch vs. Montreal, would replace Hallander
home.summary: The Penguins (2-0-0) are off a 6-5 overtime win over Montreal and are projected to start Sergei Murashov in net after Arturs Silovs started the first two games. Bryan Rust remains week to week despite participating in morning skate, while Blake Lizotte's status is uncertain after a lower-body injury. Ville Koivunen may return to the lineup after being a healthy scratch, potentially replacing Filip Hallander. The team remains otherwise intact with key veterans in the lineup.
